title: Package Sus Detector output
description: One dataset item per checked package (verdict, riskScore, reasons) plus a final summary item. The same summary is stored in the key-value store under the key SUMMARY.

results.title: Package verdicts
results.description: Dataset items: one per package with verdict (ok / caution / suspicious / not_found / error), riskScore 0-100 and machine-readable reasons; the last item is the run summary.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON summary: verdict counts, overall status, worst offenders, known-vulnerability totals.
